about: Every one of the 163 pages of a 1957 biography that Gpura has no text for: covers, title page, contents, 13 chapters. Median page: 99.9% of the printed ink inside encoded lines, 99.8% of its text reproduced.

layout: Prose with reader underlining and handwriting
about: A reader underlined lines in ballpoint and wrote in the margin. The encoding keeps the print, the underlining and the handwriting apart, each tied to its place on the scan. Reviewed by a person.

layout: Map with labels and reader notes
about: A map with printed labels and a reader's notes. Labels are left as marked gaps rather than guessed; the reader's notes are encoded as handwriting.

scores.note: map drawing and labels are deliberately not encoded as lines

about: Display type of several sizes, English and Malayalam. Lines in large type are found less reliably than body text.
Twelve chapters with page numbers after leader dots, each row kept as one line.

layout: Multi-column weekly with pictures and advertisements
about: Four columns, headlines, a portrait and advertisement boxes. Lines are found by the Surya detector; the page is only partly reconstructed so far.
A grammar book's table of case endings: every cell is a line of its own.

text: Sarvam Vision; parts labelled by AI
about: A page of Gundert's Malayalam–English Dictionary (1872). Entries are found from the hanging indent; each is encoded in TEI with headword, transliteration, etymology, senses, English glosses, examples with sources, usage labels, cross-references and derived words.
English text wrapped around an illustration; the picture itself is not mistaken for text.
A 1903 contents page with dotted leaders, in a type of its time.
A page Gpura already has text for: its text placed line by line on the scan.
A newspaper front page with hundreds of small lines. The layout is mostly captured; the text only partly.
